mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, after_sales_type, status, reason, description, images, refund_amount, actual_refund_amount, review_comment, shipping_company, tracking_number, return_note, receive_status, receive_note, create_time, update_time FROM after_sales WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales ( order_id, order_item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, after_sales_type, status, reason, description, images, refund_amount, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{afterSalesType}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{description}, #{images,typeHandler=com.group8.handler.JsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{refundAmount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales SET status = #{status}, actual_refund_amount = #{actualRefundAmount}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, shipping_company = #{shippingCompany}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, return_note = #{returnNote}, receive_status = #{receiveStatus}, receive_note = #{receiveNote}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
